title: 第一卷 第21章 天才对峙，暗流汹涌
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
收拾妥当，苏玄尘继续向秘境腹地深入。

    越是往里，灵气越是浓郁，遇到的弟子也越来越多。

    不少外门佼佼者汇聚在此，彼此划分区域，各自搜寻高阶灵材。

    林间一片开阔的青石平地之上，七八名弟子围成一团，气氛紧绷。

    为首之人，正是外门第一天才林辰。

    他一身青衫纤尘不染，负手而立，炼气九层巅峰的修为气息徐徐散开，压迫感十足。

    对面三名弟子同样气息不弱，皆是炼气七层、八层的好手，隐隐与林辰一方分庭抗礼。

    “这片灵泉区域，是我们先发现的，林师兄这般强行抢占，未免太过霸道。”

    对面一名圆脸弟子沉声开口，眼底满是不甘。

    青石平地中央，有一汪清浅泉眼，泉水汩汩涌动，灵气氤氲不散。

    这是聚灵泉，身处泉眼周边修行，吸纳灵气的速度能提升近一倍，乃是秘境中难得的宝地。

    林辰嘴角勾起一抹冷傲笑意，目光扫过对方三人：“秘境之中，机缘强者居之。你们三人修为尚可，却也配不上这处灵泉。识相的，立刻退走，免得伤了同门和气。”

    他在外门横行惯了，自认实力冠绝众人，根本没将眼前几人放在眼里。

    身旁追随者也纷纷出言嘲讽，气焰嚣张。

    双方剑拔弩张，眼看就要大打出手。

    周围不少路过的弟子纷纷驻足围观，议论声此起彼伏。

    “林师兄实力太强，那三人怕是讨不到好处。”

    “可惜了这处聚灵泉，落到林辰手里，旁人再无机会。”

    “听说林辰一直在秘境寻找突破契机，想来是想借着灵泉之力，一举踏入筑基境。”
content_en:
After packing up, Su Xuanchen continued to go deep into the hinterland of the secret realm.

    The further you go in, the richer the spiritual energy becomes, and you encounter more and more disciples.

    Many outstanding people from the outer sect gathered here, dividing areas among themselves, and searching for high-level spiritual materials.

    On an open bluestone flat in the forest, seven or eight disciples gathered in a group, and the atmosphere was tense.

    The leader was Lin Chen, the first genius of the outer sect.

    He was dressed in a green shirt that was spotless, standing with his hands behind his back. The aura of his cultivation at the ninth level of Qi Refining slowly spread out, giving him a full sense of oppression.

    The three disciples on the opposite side also had strong auras. They were all experts at the seventh and eighth levels of Qi refining, and they were faintly on par with Lin Chen.

    "We discovered this spiritual spring area first. It would be too overbearing for Senior Brother Lin to seize it by force."

    A round-faced disciple opposite spoke in a deep voice, his eyes filled with unwillingness.

    In the center of the bluestone flat, there is a clear and shallow spring. The spring water is surging and the spiritual energy is dense and lingering.

    This is the Spirit Gathering Spring. If you practice around the spring, the speed of absorbing spiritual energy can be nearly doubled. It is a rare treasure in the secret realm.

    A cold and arrogant smile appeared at the corner of Lin Chen's lips, and he glanced at the other three: "In the secret realm, those with strong opportunities live. The three of you have good cultivation, but you are not worthy of this spiritual spring. Those who know the truth, please retreat immediately, so as not to hurt the harmony of your fellow sects."

    He was used to running rampant in the outer sect. He believed that his strength was the best among all, and he didn't take the few people in front of him seriously at all.

    The followers around him also taunted and became arrogant.

    The two sides were at war with each other and were about to fight.

    Many disciples passing by stopped to watch, and they started talking one after another.

    "Senior Brother Lin is too strong, and those three people may not be able to get any benefits."

    "It's a pity that this Spirit Gathering Spring fell into Lin Chen's hands, and others will never have a chance."

    "I heard that Lin Chen has been looking for a breakthrough opportunity in the secret realm. I think he wants to use the power of the spiritual spring to enter the foundation building realm in one fell swoop."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 21 Confrontation between geniuses, turbulent undercurrents
